article.title: How Undersea Internet Cables Are Repaired

paragraphs.en: Most international internet traffic travels through fiber-optic cables on the ocean floor, not through satellites. These cables carry enormous volumes of data between continents. They are protected by several layers of material, yet they can still be damaged. Fishing equipment, ship anchors, underwater landslides, and earthquakes are among the possible causes. When a cable fails, internet traffic may be redirected through other routes, but this does not mean the disruption is harmless. Networks with limited alternative connections may experience slower service or temporary outages. Repairing a cable requires a combination of precise diagnosis, specialized ships, and careful work at sea.
paragraphs.zh: 大部分跨洲網路流量透過海底光纖，而不是衛星傳送。海纜承載大量資料，雖有多層保護，仍可能被漁具、船錨、海底滑坡或地震破壞。故障時流量可改道，但替代路線不足的地區可能變慢或中斷。維修需要精確診斷、專用船舶及細緻的海上作業。
paragraphs.ja: 国際インターネット通信の多くは衛星ではなく海底光ファイバーケーブルを通ります。漁具、錨、海底地滑り、地震などで損傷する場合があります。通信は別経路に迂回できますが、代替経路が少ない地域では遅延や停止が起こります。

paragraphs.en: The first challenge is locating the fault. Engineers monitor electrical and optical signals from cable landing stations on land. Specialized measurements can estimate how far along a cable the problem lies. However, an estimated distance is not always the same as an exact geographic position because the cable may follow a curved route across the seabed. Operators combine test results with route maps, water depth, and other observations. They must also determine whether the problem affects a fiber, a power supply component, or the physical cable itself. Accurate diagnosis prevents a repair vessel from wasting days searching in the wrong location.
paragraphs.zh: 第一個難題是定位故障。工程師從陸地登陸站監測電訊號與光訊號，利用特殊量測估計故障距離。但纜線在海床上彎曲，距離不等於精確地理位置，因此還要結合路線圖、水深與其他觀測。也必須判斷是光纖、供電元件或纜線本體出問題。準確診斷可避免維修船浪費時間。
paragraphs.ja: まず陸上の陸揚げ局から光信号や電気信号を測り、故障までの距離を推定します。海底ケーブルは曲がって敷設されるため、距離だけでは場所が決まりません。海図や水深を照合し、光ファイバーか給電設備かも確認します。

paragraphs.en: After the likely location is identified, a specialized cable ship travels to the area. The vessel carries spare cable, joining equipment, navigation systems, and technicians trained for offshore operations. Weather and sea conditions strongly influence the schedule. Strong waves can make it unsafe to handle a cable, even if the ship has reached the correct coordinates. Repair permits may also be needed, especially near national waters or busy shipping routes. Coordinating these requirements is part of the job. The actual repair may be relatively short compared with the time spent mobilizing a vessel and waiting for suitable conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 找到可能位置後，專用海纜船前往現場。船上有備用纜線、接續設備、導航系統及專業技師。天氣與海況會強烈影響進度，即使抵達正確座標，大浪也可能讓操作不安全。靠近領海或繁忙航道時還可能需要許可。實際修理時間有時比調船與等待合適海況更短。
paragraphs.ja: 故障地点が推定されると、予備ケーブルや接続装置を積んだ専用船が向かいます。悪天候では作業できず、海域によっては許可も必要です。修理そのものより船の手配や天候待ちに時間がかかる場合があります。

paragraphs.en: In relatively shallow water, crews may use a grapnel to hook the cable and lift it to the surface. In deeper water, remotely operated vehicles can help locate or inspect the damaged section. The team cuts out the faulty part, brings the cable ends aboard when feasible, and splices in a replacement section. Fiber connections must be made with great precision because small alignment errors can reduce signal quality. Technicians test the repaired connection before lowering the cable back to the seabed. Additional cable length may be needed to allow the joined section to rest safely along the ocean floor.
paragraphs.zh: 較淺水域可用抓鉤勾起纜線並拉到海面；較深水域可能使用遙控潛水器定位或檢查。技師移除損壞段，將可行的纜線端拉上船，接入替換纜線。光纖接續必須精密，微小偏差就可能降低訊號品質。測試完成後再將纜線放回海床，接合段也可能需要額外長度以安全鋪放。
paragraphs.ja: 浅い海ではグラプネルでケーブルを引き上げ、深い海では遠隔操作機器で調査することがあります。損傷部を切り取り、新しい区間を接続します。光ファイバーの接続精度を検査し、海底に戻します。

paragraphs.en: Repairing a cable does not always restore full network resilience immediately. Operators must verify the link, reconfigure traffic, and confirm that services remain stable. A region may depend on several cables that share the same landing station or pass through the same narrow corridor. Such concentration creates common points of failure. Building diverse routes, maintaining spare capacity, and arranging access to repair ships can reduce risk. These measures are expensive, so network planners must compare their cost with the consequences of prolonged disruption. Resilience is therefore an economic decision as well as a technical one.
paragraphs.zh: 修好纜線不代表網路韌性立刻完全恢復。業者需驗證連線、重新配置流量並確認服務穩定。如果多條海纜共用登陸站或狹窄通道，就可能一起受損。路線多樣化、備援容量與維修船調度可降低風險，但成本不低，因此網路規劃也是經濟決策。
paragraphs.ja: 修理後も回線を検証し、通信経路を再設定する必要があります。複数のケーブルが同じ陸揚げ局や海域に集中すると共通の障害点になります。経路分散、予備容量、修理船へのアクセスが重要です。

paragraphs.en: Undersea cables are a reminder that the digital world depends on physical infrastructure. A message may cross oceans in milliseconds, but repairing the path it uses can require ships, skilled labor, permits, and favorable weather. No single cable can guarantee uninterrupted connectivity. The practical lesson is to design networks that can tolerate failures and recover from them. Users rarely see the work of cable technicians, yet their efforts help keep businesses, hospitals, researchers, and families connected across continents.
paragraphs.zh: 海底光纜提醒我們，數位世界依賴實體基礎設施。訊息跨海只需毫秒，修復傳輸路徑卻可能需要船舶、技術人員、許可與好天氣。沒有任何單條纜線能保證不中斷。實務重點是設計能承受故障並恢復的網路。海纜技師的工作讓企業、醫院、研究者與家庭保持跨洲連結。
paragraphs.ja: デジタル通信は物理インフラに支えられています。通信は瞬時でも修理には船、人員、許可、天候が必要です。一本のケーブルに依存せず、障害に耐え復旧できるネットワーク設計が重要です。
